{{Quote|The great Thi-Sen, "Son of Suns," asks again that you leave or it will mean war.|C-3PO, to Chairman Chi Cho|<ref name="TCWTrespass" />}}
'''Thi-Sen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] who was the [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] of a group of [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], both sides, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], sent a task force to the planet. While the Republic [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|troops]] tested [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the Separatists [[Skirmish on Orto Plutonia/Legends|attacked]] the peaceful Talz. This resulted in a Talz counterattack in which both the [[Glid Station/Legends|Glid Station]] Republic outpost and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces were destroyed. The Republic sent on behalf of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] Orto Plutonia, [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]], another task force of troops under the command of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

After discovering the disheveled base and destroyed battle droids, the new task force found the [[Talz village/Legends|Talz village]]. Thi-Sen's aide, [[Medcha Wanto/Legends|Medcha Wanto]], brought the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to the [[Chieftain's hut (Talz village)/Legends|Chieftain's hut]], whereupon Thi-Sen and the Jedi agreed upon a ceasefire and came to an arrangement with the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] chairman.

Chairman Cho, however, believed that the Talz were trespassers and declared war on them during meeting. While the Jedi ordered their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to protect Cho, they went back to the base to speak with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]]. The Talz [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|attacked]] the troops protecting Cho, [[Death/Legends|killing]] many clone troopers and badly wounding Cho, but also taking casualties self. After cornering the clone troopers, Republic troops arrived and Thi-Sen ordered to halt the charge. Chuchi meanwhile had get the approval to make peace with the Talz and after Cho died, approached Thi-Sen along with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and made peace with the Talz and the Republic troops left Orto Plutonia.

==Biography==
[[File:Thi-Sen_narglatch.png|thumb|left|180px|Thi-Sen astride his narglatch mount]]

A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] Thi-Sen was a leader of a secretive tribe of his people on the frozen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], both sides, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], sent an amount of [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to Orto Plutonia. While the Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] tested some [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the Separatists [[Skirmish on Orto Plutonia/Legends|attacked]] the Talz. Thi-Sen took this as a threat to their territory and he counterattacked both sides eliminating the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers as well as the battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and they wiped out both. However the attack at the [[Glid Station/Legends|Republic outpost]] brought, on behalf of the neighboring [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]], an investigation, consisting of [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] as well as [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="TCWTrespass" /><ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap">''[[The Clone Wars: Cold Snap]]''</ref>

While investigating the massacre of both troops, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] noticed the [[Talz village/Legends|Talz village]] where they were greeted by Thi-Sen's aide, [[Medcha Wanto/Legends|Medcha Wanto]], and brought to the [[Chieftain's hut (Talz village)/Legends|Chieftain's hut]]. There, using a primitive form of communication, Thi-Sen told the Jedi what had happened and that he and his people only wanted to be left alone. The Jedi organized a meeting for him and Pantorian representatives, and Thi-Sen was gladdened by the prospect of a peaceful solution, giving Kenobi a bear hug before the Jedi left.<ref name="TCWTrespass" />

Thi-Sen's Talz came to the meeting in the wreckage of some destroyed Confederate [[XT Beetle Transport/Legends|XT Beetle Transports]] and politely asked the Pantorans to leave his world. However, [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] didn't want to lose ownership of Orto Plutonia and at the meeting called the Talz trespassers and savages, using the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to communicate with the Talz. Once again, Thi-Sen said he and his people wanted to live in peace, and asked the Pantorans to pull their people off the planet. Cho, refusing to use diplomacy, deliberately provoked and offended the Talz. Thi-Sen stated that there would be war if the Pantorans didn't do as he asked, and Cho accepted the challenge.<ref name="TCWTrespass" />

With [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|war]] officially declared, the Jedi left for the Republic base to request that Senator Chuchi make contact with the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]] to declare Cho out of order and strip him of power. Thi-Sen rallied his massive army and led his people against the Pantorans and Republic. Engaging the clone troopers assigned to protect the Chairman, Thi-Sen's forces quickly overwhelmed the Republic troops, mortally wounding Cho and [[Death/Legends|killing]] several clone troopers. After the Talz cornered the surviving clones, reinforcements of the Republic arrived in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]]. Chuchi,who had been given authority to negotiate with the Talz by the Pantoran Assembly in the interest of peace, arrived and Thi-Sen chose to stop the attack. Chairman Cho, who had been struck in the back by a spear during the battle, appealed to Senator Chuchi to continue to fight the Talz, proclaiming that it was for the "good" of his people, and was shocked to hear that his authority had been overruled by the Pantoran Assembly, he died shortly thereafter. Chuchi along with C-3PO approached Thi-Sen and told him that it is a greater sacrifice to live for his people then to die for them. The Senator then offered to concede the sovereignty of Plutonia to the Talz and Thi-Sen agreed. The Republic troops left Orto Plutonia and the Talz were left in peace.<ref name="TCWTrespass" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Chuchi_peace.png|thumb|left|180px|Thi-Sen and Senator Chuchi making peace]]

Thi-Sen was called the "[[Son of Suns/Legends|Son of Suns]]" by the people of his tribe, and wore the headpiece made from the tailbone of a [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]] as a sign of his position of leadership. His weapons of choice were a spear and cudgel.<ref name="DB" /> Thi-Sen was willing to fight to protect his people and home, but unlike Chi Cho, he was willing, and prefered, to seek peaceful solutions to problems. Also, he personally led his troops in battle and only wanted peace for his people.<ref name="TCWTrespass" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thi-Sen was featured in "[[Trespass]]," a [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episode of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']], written by [[Steven Melching]], directed by [[Brian Kalin O'Connell]] and aired at [[January 30]], [[2009]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]] who also voiced all clone troopers in the series.<ref name="Trespass Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode015.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Trespass}}</ref> Thi-Sen's title "Son of Suns" is an artifact from some of the earliest ''Star Wars'' draft scripts. The second draft screenplay began with a prophetic quote about a legendary savior who would emerge during the time of greatest despair.<ref name="DB" />
